title: BACKND Base game log
summary: Store game logs from the client with InsertLogV2 (logType plus a Param payload). V2 incurs only a call cost and no DB write throughput, unlike the legacy InsertLog. Logs are viewable in the BACKND console.
capabilities: explain the V2 cost model (no DB write throughput)
describe logType plus Param payload structure
prerequisites: SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
A logType convention is defined for the game
common_pitfalls: Using legacy InsertLog (incurs DB write cost) instead of InsertLogV2
Overloading a single logType for unrelated events
verification_required_for: exact method signature and Param shape
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating logging code.
Prefer InsertLogV2; confirm the current cost model upstream.
public_notes: InsertLogV2 avoids DB write throughput cost; legacy InsertLog does not.
Logs are inspected in the console.
